verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੮ : ਚਰਨਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਦਾ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼
verses.translit_en: pauRee 18 : charanaa(n) to(n) ni(n)mrataa dhaa upadhesh

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਉਚਾ ਨੀਵੇਂ ਚਰਣ ਸਿਰਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਂਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: sir uchaa neeve(n) charan sir pairee paa(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The head is high and the feet are at a low level but still the head bows upon the feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹੁ ਅਖੀ ਨਕੁ ਕੰਨ ਹਥ ਦੇਹ ਭਾਰ ਉਚਾਂਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: muh akhee nak ka(n)n hath dheh bhaar uchaa(n)dhe|

en.bdb: The feet carry the burden of mouth, eyes, nose, ears, hands and the whole body.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਚਿਹਨ ਛਡਿ ਪੂਜੀਅਨਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਂਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: sabh chihan chhadd poojeean kaun karam kamaa(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Then, leaving aside all the body organs, only they (feet) are worshipped.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤੀ ਨਿਤ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਜਾਂਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: gur saranee saadhasa(n)gatee nit chal chal jaa(n)dhe|

en.bdb: They daily go to the holy congregation in the shelter of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਤਨਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਵਸਾਂਦੇ।
verses.translit_en: vatan paraupakaar no kar paar vasaa(n)dhe|

en.bdb: Then they run for the altruistic works and accomplish the work to the maximum possible.
Alas! Were it so that shoes made of my skin were used by the Sikhs of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕ ਲਗੇ ਸਾਧ ਰੇਣੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: masatak lage saadh ren vaddabhaag jinhaa(n) dhe ||18||

en.bdb: Whosoever gets the dust of the feet of such people (with above virtues) he is fortunate and a blessed one.
